description:
The food.gdt dataset is open in Gretl. It contains real household survey data with two variables: 'food_exp' (weekly food expenditure in dollars) and 'income' (weekly income in $100 units) for 40 households.

Compute descriptive (summary) statistics for all variables in the dataset. Use the menu: View > Summary statistics, then select all variables (or use Edit > Select all) and click OK. When the results window appears showing statistics such as mean, median, standard deviation, min, and max, save the output as a text file to /home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/summary_stats.txt using File > Save to file in the results window.

metadata.data_source: Hill, Griffiths, Lim - Principles of Econometrics 5th ed, household survey data
